tests/test_event_triggers.py.purpose: Integration tests for event sources/triggers: durable ingest, dedupe, lifecycle, provider polling/socket recovery, self-event suppression.

responsibilities.text: Signed webhook ingress commits events before admitting owner-authority work; rejects bad signatures, replays and oversized bodies
Dedupe, fan-out, coalescing, queue caps and daily allowance behavior of trigger runs
Trigger/source lifecycle (pause, archive, edit, connection token change) cancels unstarted work and preserves started work and history
Provider collectors: cursor atomicity, baselines, resync, Drive/Calendar/Gmail/GitHub/Slack normalization and socket ack durability
Self-event suppression against connector_operations receipts
Owner API privacy and preview: secrets never echoed, preview creates no work

discrepancies.text: phase5_exit_acceptance verify()/cleanup() require proof keys restart_verified, closed_tab_result_navigation_verified and closed_tab_task_id that no script in the repo writes; they must be hand-edited into /app/test-results/phase5-exit-live.json, so the gate cannot pass autonomously and cleanup raises KeyError otherwise.

Unit module test_phase4_acceptance_evidence imports live-acceptance modules (phase4_read_acceptance -> protocol_acceptance) whose import has side effects: os.environ["OWNER_TOKEN"] KeyError if unset and an httpx client is constructed at import. Pure verifier tests therefore cannot be collected without live-stack env.

Unit tests load code from container-absolute paths (/app/docker/capability_filter.py, /app/plugins/hermbot/__init__.py, /app/docker/runtime_api.py) so they only run inside the container image, not from a checkout.

test_outside_requested_scope_requires_review_and_policy_can_require_review only asserts the out-of-scope review half; the policy-forces-review half is covered separately in test_review_policy_is_enforced_again_before_dispatch, so the name overstates the test.

Acceptance scripts hard-code environment specifics: synthetic Slack member UHERMBOTTEST, default recipient dhruv@turboml.com, teammate display names (Scout/Quill/Sage), http://api:8000 base URL and /app/test-results manifest paths; phase3_exit also needs a local fixture page on 127.0.0.1:8099 and a canary string.

Browser scripts disagree on base URL handling: ui-regressions honors HERMBOT_TEST_URL while work-controller.mjs and work-outcomes.mjs hard-code http://api:8000; ui-regressions also needs real data (multiple groups, completed workflows) unlike the fixture-driven work-*.mjs, so it is not hermetic.
phase3_exit.py dispatches on sys.argv[1]=="start" and treats any other value as verify (no explicit verify literal), and raises IndexError with no argument.

Tests exercise tool_action operations publish_file, ask and work_status (and plugin tools hermbot_publish_file/ask/work_status) but architecture ids.txt has no tool: nodes for them, so those edges could not be expressed.
